Definition
[semilinear heat operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0030 1. ch10:eq-10.1\group Scalar maximum principles

Let $M^n$ be a closed manifold equipped with metrics $g(t)$. Let $X(t)$ be a time-dependent vector field and let $F:\mathbb R\times [0,T]\to \mathbb R$ be continuous and locally Lipschitz in its first variable. Set \[ Lu=\partial _tu-\Delta _{g(t)}u-\langle X(t),\nabla u\rangle -F(u,t). \]
